name: dbt-mcp
description: MCP server for dbt — inspect model errors, run models, read test results, trace lineage, and browse the project manifest.

DBT_PROJECT_DIR.description: Absolute path to the dbt project root (the directory containing dbt_project.yml)

DBT_PROFILES_DIR.description: Directory containing profiles.yml; defaults to ~/.dbt if not set

DBT_TARGET.description: dbt target name to use from profiles.yml (e.g. dev, prod)
